import sys, random, ctypes
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
from t_common import *
import scamp_pipeline as sp, scamp_accel
acc = scamp_accel.Accel('/app/submit'); assert acc.available
lib = acc.lib
M = (1<<128)-1
cases = []
# adversarial address sets
cases.append([('all zero/one', [(0,0,1),(M,128,2),(M&sp.TMASK[1],1,3),(1<<127,1,4),(M>>1|1,128,5)])])
cases.append([('boundary lengths', [(sp.TMASK[l] & (rng:=random.Random(l)).getrandbits(128), l, l) for l in range(0,129)])])
cases.append([('single chain', [(sp.TMASK[l] & 0x20010db8000000000000000000000000, l, 1) for l in range(0,129,3)])])
cases.append([('two hot spots', [((0x20010db8 << 96) | (i << 32), 128, i) for i in range(200)] +
                                [((0xfe80 << 112) | (i << 64), 96, i) for i in range(200)])])
cases.append([('dup truncations', [(0x20010db8000000000000000000000000 | i, 128, i) for i in range(300)])])
cases.append([('dense low lengths', [(i << 120, 8, i) for i in range(256)])])
cases.append([('mixed lengths same addr', [(0x20010db800000001 << 64 | 0x1234, l, l) for l in [32,33,48,64,65,96,97,128]])
              if False else ('mixed lengths same addr', [( (0x20010db800000001 << 64 | 0x1234) & sp.TMASK[l], l, l) for l in [32,33,48,64,65,96,97,128]])])
rng = random.Random(17)
for name, fib in [c[0] for c in cases]:
    seen=set(); f2=[]
    for (a,l,h) in fib:
        a &= sp.TMASK[l]
        if (a,l) in seen: continue
        seen.add((a,l)); f2.append((a,l,h))
    fib=f2
    for ms in (1,2,7,8,32):
        fs = sorted(fib, key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1]))
        Up = sp.py_utab(fs, ms)
        rc, cuts, used_c, num, den = acc.find_cuts([(a,l) for (a,l,h) in fib], [10**9]*8, 8, ms)
        # verify used from C matches python layout for the returned cuts
        if rc == 0:
            stages, used_py = sp.build_layout(fib, cuts)
            assert used_py == used_c, (name, ms, cuts, used_py, used_c)
            assert (num,den) == sp.peak_of(used_py, [10**9]*8), (name, ms)
            nv = naive_layout_used(fib, cuts)
            assert nv == used_c, (name, ms, nv, used_c)
        # verify a sample of U entries against the naive transcription
        for b in range(0,128,3):
            for e in range(b+1, min(b+ms,128)+1, 2):
                assert Up[b][e] == naive_U(fib,b,e), (name, ms, b, e, Up[b][e], naive_U(fib,b,e))
    print('%-24s n=%-4d OK' % (name, len(fib)))
print('ADVERSARIAL UTAB OK')
EOF
